name: Android no Koi to Yume
original_name: アンドロイドの恋と夢
source:
You, a genius researcher, created a handsome android with silver hair!

You are trying to push the concept of "love" and "romanticism" into him, but you have no romantic experience whatsoever!

"I need to experiment love with someone, then I'll collect come samples"

And the individual you choose for your experiment is...
